objective: To process the DTP records submitted on DTP Creation: create one Daily order per record for the LP Admin (Planning Order / DTP Creation Release).
In case of an error the record is set to FAILED with the reason; the planner can retry it. Successful records are never processed twice.

steps.text: Log message no. 1. Retrieve DTP_QUEUE_BATCH_SIZE and DTP_QUEUE_MAX_ATTEMPT from System Master (TB_M_SYSTEM, TBD) (TBD).
children: Not configured: log message no. 3. Stop.
DB connection error: log message no. 2. Stop.

steps.text: Select up to the batch size from ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL WHERE STATUS IN ('SUBMITTED', 'QUEUED') ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DT, DTP_DET_ID (row lock, skip locked); SUBMITTED records are set to QUEUED first.
Per record (own transaction): set STATUS 'PROCESSING', ATTEMPT_CNT + 1, history.
Re-check that LP is active and FROM / TO are still in the data mapping.
children: Not valid: go to step 7 with message no. 5.

steps.text: Create the Daily order (Planning Order) and its first cycle (DTP Creation Release) with a new ORDER_NO (refer 4.2).
children: Error / timeout: rollback the order, go to step 7 with message no. 6.

steps.text: Set the record PROCESSED with ORDER_NO, clear FAIL_REASON, history; commit. Log message no. 8. The order is visible for the LP Admin (Daily Monitoring).
Set the record FAILED with FAIL_REASON, history; commit. The planner can Retry (status back to QUEUED).
Next record; when all are handled, log message no. 9. Exit.

func_desc.text: Background service for the records submitted on DTP Creation. Each record is handled in its own transaction so one failure never blocks the others.

items: One order per DTP record; type UNIVERSAL; status Planning Order; first cycle DTP Creation Release (same as orders created by DTP Check & Submit).
LP name and location names come from the masters / data mapping; Planned Cycle = 2 when IS_ROUNDUSE = 'Y', else 1 (TBD OP-05).
The LP Admin sees the order in Daily Monitoring (Truck Assignment menu TBD); Reject by LP returns it to the planner (calendar: Rejected by LP).
Only SUBMITTED / QUEUED records are selected; PROCESSED is final.
Row lock (skip locked) prevents two runs from taking the same record.
ORDER_NO is written in the same transaction as the order; a rollback leaves the record without order (FAILED).
Master changed since submit (no. 5): FAILED; correct master, then Retry.
Order creation error / timeout (no. 6): FAILED, retryable.
Attempts >= max (no. 7): stays FAILED, notification TBD (OP-08).

func_desc.text: The Daily order keeps the Payment Type of its DTP record. Submit already guarantees a valid Payment Type for companies with Master KPI (DTP Creation KM-15); the queue does not change it.

Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Revised (DCR) = existing application logic kept, the table needs the DB change request listed below; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts resolved (decision 14-Nov-26): existing application logic kept; DB change requests (DCR) where the table cannot hold it

items: G-DTP-01 Record table: Existing logic kept: one record list per plan date for the Universal DTP model; stored as DTP_HEADER (date) + DTP_2_DETAIL rows (inferred DTP type). No DB change: mapping as stated.

G-DTP-02 Order number at creation: Existing logic kept: order number is assigned by queue processing, records exist before that. DCR-16: ALTER ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL: ORDER_NO NULL; primary key ORDER_NO -> DTP_DET_ID.
G-DTP-03 Payment type: Existing logic kept: Payment Type per record chosen by the planner (dtp-rules.js setPayType). DCR-17: ADD ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL.PAY_TYPE varchar(12).

G-DTP-04 Status values: Existing logic kept: record statuses Ready to Submit / Error / Queued / Processing / Processed / Failed / Rejected (dtp-rules.js S). DCR-18: Register the statuses in ielp.MS_STATUS (STATUS_TYPE for DTP records, STATUS_CODE varchar(3)) - data, no column change.

G-DTQ-01 Retry counters: Existing logic kept: retry with attempt count, failure reason, submitted by / at. DCR-21: ADD ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL.ATTEMPT_CNT int default 0, FAIL_REASON varchar(500), SUBMITTED_BY varchar(500), SUBMITTED_DT datetime.
